body.prompt: A heraldic crest: two detailed laurel branches curving up and almost meeting at the top around a small oval cameo of a bearded Roman emperor in profile, a tiny eight-pointed star above, finely engraved leaves with veins. Ultra-premium luxury heritage brand emblem, highly detailed fine-line engraving style like a banknote or a classic coin die, intricate but clean, warm ivory white lines (#F2EBDD) on a plain solid near-black background (#0B0A09), perfectly centered, the emblem fills about 75% of the frame with even margins, crisp, high contrast, flat, no color gradients, no 3D render, no glow. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no inscription, no watermark.
